newsitem.title: USA: Burlington wins NEC Technologies deal.
newsitem.headline: Burlington wins NEC Technologies deal.

text.p: Burlington Air Express said it won awarded a multi-year global logistics contract by NEC Technologies to manage its material returns.
Burlington said its BAX Global Logistics unit will manage material return authorizations, cross-shipments, carrier performance and product tracking between end-user and repair depot.

The program covers NEC Technologies' MultiSync monitors, MultiSpin(R) CD-ROM readers, and SuperScript printers, said Gene Long, Vice-president, global logistics for Burlington. --Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel +44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017
